title: Research
text:
Master’s Thesis



Master’s Thesis · 2026


Welche Faktoren erklären Wahlbeteiligung? Ein Vergleich erklärender statistischer mit explorativen Machine-Learning Ansätzen am Beispiel der Bundestagswahl 2017


Martin Preiß


Department of Political Science · University of Freiburg



Abstract


This thesis examines voter turnout in the 2017 German federal election using data from the GESIS Panel Core Studies. A theory-driven logistic regression model with 12 predictors is compared with two exploratory machine learning models, Random Forest and XGBoost, trained on 222 predictors.


All three models identify previous electoral participation, voting norms and political interest as central predictors. Machine learning additionally reveals patterns related to media consumption and political trust, while offering modest improvements in predictive performance. The findings highlight the complementary role of explanatory and predictive modelling in political science.

title: Martin Preiß
text:
Political Science | Data Science


Martin Preiß





I am a political scientist with a Master’s degree from the University of Freiburg. My research interests lie at the intersection of political science and data science, with a focus on political behaviour and quantitative research methods.


I am interested in the application of machine learning and computational methods to social science research. My previous work includes electoral research, survey data analysis and the exploration of AI-based research methods.
